note: HSK 1 reading, Taiwan edition (Traditional, Taiwan wording and readings; owner's plan 2026-10-30): the Mainland edition's format — 第一部分 看句子配圖 ×5, 第二部分 問答配對 ×5, 第三部分 選詞填空 ×5, 第四部分 讀句子回答問題 ×5. Original texts. Drafted in tools/.mockups/tw1.py.

panels: a mother buying fruit at a fruit stall in a street market
a girl watching television on a sofa at home
a father driving a small car
a boy asleep on a sofa
two students writing in notebooks at their desks in a classroom
a small dog drinking water from a bowl

questions.zh: 「我在家看電視」：B 是坐在沙發上看電視的女孩。
questions.en: "I'm watching TV at home": B, the girl on the sofa.

questions.zh: 「他們在學校學中文」：E 是在教室寫字的學生。
questions.en: "They are learning Chinese at school": E, the students writing in class.

questions.zh: 「媽媽在買水果」：A 是在水果攤買水果的媽媽。
questions.en: "Mum is buying fruit": A.

questions.zh: 「我的狗很喜歡喝水」：F 是在喝水的小狗。
questions.en: "My dog loves drinking water": F.

questions.zh: 「爸爸在開車」：C。D（在睡覺的男孩）是多出來的。
questions.en: "Dad is driving": C. D is the spare picture.

questions.zh: 問「在哪裡」，回答地點：「在台北。」
questions.en: "Where is your home?" — "In Taipei."

questions.zh: 問「他是你爸爸嗎？」，回答「不是，他是我哥哥。」
questions.en: "Is he your dad?" — "No, he's my older brother."

questions.zh: 別人說「對不起」，回答「沒關係。」
questions.en: "Sorry I'm late." — "That's all right."

questions.zh: 問想「喝」什麼，回答「我想喝茶。」
questions.en: "What would you like to drink?" — "I'd like tea."

questions.zh: 問「幾點」，回答時間：「十二點。」F「很好吃！」是多出來的。
questions.en: "What time shall we go and eat?" — "Twelve." F is the spare.

questions.zh: 「坐車」：我們坐車去學校吧。
questions.en: 坐车, to go by car / bus: let's take the bus to school.

questions.zh: 人的量詞是「個」：兩個中國朋友。
questions.en: 个 is the measure word for people: two Chinese friends.

questions.zh: 「在」＋地方＋做什麼：我爸爸在醫院工作。
questions.en: 在 + a place + what one does: my dad works at a hospital.

questions.zh: 「會」＋說：他會說一點中文。
questions.en: 会 + speak: he can speak a little Chinese.

questions.zh: 「都」：我們家每個人都喜歡看書。「下」是多出來的。
questions.en: 都, all: everyone in our family likes reading. 下 is the spare.

items.text: 我在台北的一家商店工作，我很喜歡這個工作。

tr.en: I work in a shop in Taipei, and I really like this job.

questions.zh: 「我在台北的一家商店工作」。
questions.en: "I work in a shop in Taipei."

items.text: 今天是星期六，我和朋友去看電影。

tr.en: Today is Saturday; I'm going to see a film with a friend.

questions.zh: 「今天是星期六」。
questions.en: "Today is Saturday."

items.text: 王老師有一個女兒，她女兒今年七歲。

tr.en: Teacher Wang has a daughter, who is seven this year.

questions.zh: 「她女兒今年七歲」。
questions.en: "Her daughter is seven this year."

items.text: 天氣太熱了，我們下午在家看書，不去看電影了。

tr.en: It's too hot; this afternoon we'll read at home instead of going to the cinema.

questions.zh: 「我們下午在家看書，不去看電影了」。
questions.en: "This afternoon we'll read at home."

items.text: 這本書是我同學的，不是我的。

tr.en: This book is my classmate's, not mine.

questions.zh: 「這本書是我同學的，不是我的」。
questions.en: "It's my classmate's, not mine."
